text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sustained QPS spike for org=aurelia-labs, 95th pctl latency rising, errors ~8%. Auto-throttle triggered but customers reporting degraded UX. Paging oncall.

erik_oncall: on it. paging in #incidents and will take lead. can someone grab impact calc for org-level tokens?

devon_infra: seeing steady 3x baseline for POST /v1/generate from aur-labs keys, early signs of retry storms. origin region: us-west2.

tanvi_sre: tagged as sev1. I’ll run quick traffic-shaping to protect platform. plan: temporarily lower org RL to 60% and disable non-essential endpoints (image-ops) for the org only.

kate_csm: Aurelia on a marketing promo right now — if we throttle too hard they'll lose conversions. need customer-facing note before big change. I'll standby to notify.

erik_oncall: ok make the change with minimal user impact — prefer reducing burst cap and disabling long-running ops vs hard tokens cut. devon, can you prepare a targeted hotfix for org=aur-labs?

devon_infra: preparing patch. will apply a per-org rate limit override via /admin/orgs/aur-labs/rl PATCH. snippet:

```
PATCH /admin/orgs/aur-labs/rl
{ "qps": 300, "burst": 600, "disable_endpoints": ["image-generate", "file-upload"] }
```

Applying in 30s unless objections.

tanvi_sre: +1. also enabling short-circuit fallback to smaller model for that org: route model:big -> model-small on overflow.

mike_runtime: deploying route rule now. commands:

```
rbx apply --env prod --file aur-rl-hotfix.yaml
# aur-rl-hotfix.yaml contains per-org rl + route fallback
```

Deploy started 4521010200.

erik_oncall: kate please send an empathetic pre-notice: 5-10min window, temporary reduced throughput for media features only. tag support.

kate_csm: drafting now. will post to aur-labs slack and email. message: "We're applying a short mitigation to preserve availability — media uploads and image generation may be slower or temporarily unavailable for up to 15 minutes. We're monitoring and will update." :heart:

incident-bot: Action logged: deploy started by mike_runtime. Incident ID INC-2026-4521. Notifying support rotation.

tanvi_sre: metrics after rule at 4521010800: QPS down to ~1.1x baseline, errors dropped to 1.5%, p95 latency back to target. CPU on pool nodes stabilized.

erik_oncall: good. keep an eye on retry queues and cache hit rate. if retries spike we may need to add temporary quota token to key owners.

devon_infra: seeing some clients still hammering via retries. I pushed a short-lived org token throttle reduction to 250 qps and increased per-client backoff header via gateway (x-retry-after: 6s).

mike_runtime: hotfix finished 4521011200, rollout 100% for org override. I left a revert job scheduled in 20m.

erik_oncall: kate confirm customer notified?

kate_csm: posted to their ops channel and emailed primary contact. they acknowledged and asked for a follow-up in 30m. included escalation phone.

tanvi_sre: monitoring continues. plan to slowly lift restrictions if stable. timeline: re-evaluate at +15 and +30.

erik_oncall: agreed. timeline noted. document commands used and add to postmortem. quick checklist for exec summary:
- root cause: promo traffic + aggressive client retries
- mitigation: per-org rl override, disabled media endpoints, route fallback to smaller model
- customer comms: yes
- follow-up: analyze retry policy, consider grace burst for paid promo windows

incident-bot: Reminder: scheduled revert job will run at 4521012000 unless aborted.

devon_infra: aborting revert — we'll honor customer preference to keep slightly elevated burst for promo. cancel revert job.

mike_runtime: revert canceled at 4521012300. keeping reduced controls in place and monitoring.

erik_oncall: closing active mitigation thread but keeping incident open for postmortem. great coordination — thanks team. :thumbsup:

kate_csm: customer happy with proactive note. will follow up with a customer-facing recap and postmortem link when ready.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-4521 state: mitigation applied, monitoring. Assigned to tanvi_sre for postmortem."
